name: Trust status
trust_basis: The canonical trust-status vocabulary is synchronized by tests and schema checks, but this enum is not itself a runtime verification target.
description: Defines the trust-status vocabulary used to describe claim credibility separately from lifecycle status.
definition: Trust status records credibility while status records lifecycle.

value_definitions.verified: The claim has targeted executable verification and must pass grounded verify.
value_definitions.checkable: The claim is structurally checkable through verification, or records why it is not wired yet.
value_definitions.observed: The claim is based on cited observation, source references, or an explicit observed basis.
value_definitions.aspirational: The claim is proposed or future intent, not current truth.
value_definitions.unknown: No stronger credibility claim is made.
